scene: You uncover a glowing brass key and an ancient skull.
picture: First-person close-up looking down into a wooden sandbox filled with pale sand. On the left, a glowing brass key protrudes from the dirt. In the centre sits a half-buried fossil skull with tiny ridged horns. On the right, a red metal shovel is stuck upright in the sand. Two small hands rest along the wooden rim.
shown: a shiny brass key sticking up in the sand on the left
a large horned fossil skull resting in the sand at centre
a red toy shovel planted upright in the sand on the right

variants.scene: A shimmering golden key and a horned fossil rest inside the sandbox.
Sand dust settles over ancient bones and a mysterious, sparkling antique key.
You lean over the wooden frame, spotting a gleaming key beside old fossils.
